PremiumWaitlistEntry.title: Premium Waitlist Entry
PremiumWaitlistEntry.description: Centralized record of a user who has requested early access notification for ExpenseFlow Premium.

email.description: Original formatted email provided by user.

normalizedEmail.description: Trimmed, lowercase canonical email used for duplicate checking and unique indexing.

registrationDate.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when user registered.

consentToProductUpdates.description: Explicit opt-in consent to receive product updates, launch notices, and early bird pricing.

consentTimestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when user checked the consent box.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the waitlist subscriber.

selectedPlan.description: Plan tier interest expressed by subscriber at time of registration.

BillingEntitlement.title: Billing Entitlement
BillingEntitlement.description: Server-managed verified subscription entitlement keyed by SHA-256 hash of Google Play purchase token (raw tokens are never stored).

BillingTokenIndex.title: Billing Token Index
BillingTokenIndex.description: Lookup index mapping 16-char tokenId to hashed purchase tokenHash and authenticated userId (null while unbound).

RtdnNotification.title: RTDN Notification
RtdnNotification.description: Idempotency and processing lease ledger deduplicating Google Play Real-Time Developer Notifications by Pub/Sub messageId.

AiUsageQuota.title: AI Usage Quota
AiUsageQuota.description: Durable per-subscription AI Spending Coach rate limit and monthly quota tracker.

/premium_waitlist/{waitlistId}.description: Secure collection storing centralized early-access registrations for ExpenseFlow Premium.

/billing_entitlements/{tokenHash}.description: Backend-only collection storing hashed purchase tokens and user bindings.

/billing_token_index/{tokenId}.description: Backend-only index mapping 16-char entitlement tokenIds to tokenHash.

/rtdn_notifications/{messageId}.description: Backend-only deduplication records for Google Play Pub/Sub RTDN delivery.

/ai_usage_quotas/{subjectKey}.description: Backend-only durable rate-limit and monthly AI quota counters.
